title: Design System: Vault CRM Clinical Genie

body.purpose: Assistant answers and supporting clinical context.

label.purpose: Modes, metadata, table headings, and disclosures.

shadows.name: composer-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates the persistent composer from the scrolling transcript.

motion.name: responsive-state
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and connection-state feedback only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The secure connection and primary action treatment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #2272E5; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 14px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1760C4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(34,114,229,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: User Question
components.description: A compact right-aligned question bubble matching Genie.
components.html: Show patient count and median survival by ECOG status.
components.css: .ds-user-question { max-width: 620px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 10px 10px 2px 10px; background: #7756E8; color: #FFFFFF; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The floating, touch-ready Genie question composer.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #E3E3E7; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(27,27,31,.10); } .ds-composer input { flex: 1; min-height: 36px; border: 0; outline: 0; color: #1B1B1F; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-composer button { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #2272E5; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: #2272E5; outline: 3px solid rgba(34,114,229,.16); } .ds-visually-hidden { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }

components.name: Evidence Surface
components.description: A flat surface for a Genie chart, table, or SQL disclosure.
components.html:
Patient count and median survival

Chart or governed table result
components.css: .ds-evidence { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #E3E3E7; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1B1B1F; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-evidence p { margin: 0; color: #67666D; }

narrative.overview: The interface is a wide, quiet analytical notebook in which a question, explanation, chart, and evidence read as one continuous page. Databricks Genie is the primary visual reference; Veeva contributes context and identity without wrapping the conversation in a second dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Centered transcript with generous white space
Purple user prompts and coral Genie marks

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Coral and violet together must occupy less than ten percent of the visible surface; their scarcity gives them meaning.

rules.name: The Read-It-Once Rule
rules.body: Clinical answers use sentence case, short paragraphs, and clear numerical emphasis; uppercase is prohibited outside compact status labels.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Charts, tables, and SQL disclosures never use decorative shadows; evidence sits on the notebook page, not on floating cards.

dos: Do keep the conversation centered with a maximum readable width near 960px.
Do use a 1px hairline border to organize charts, tables, and disclosures.
Do preserve at least 44px touch targets for primary iPad interactions.
Do provide descriptive chart alt text and an adjacent accessible table fallback.
donts: Don't build generic SaaS card dashboards.
Don't use glassmorphism and decorative gradients.
Don't return to teal-heavy enterprise styling unrelated to Databricks Genie.
Don't present dense developer consoles to clinical users.
Don't add decorative animation that competes with analysis.
Don't place independent shadows around analytical evidence.
